Settings

Ollama host
Point at a remote/cloud Ollama instance instead of this machine — tried before any cloud fallback below
Whisper host (speech-to-text)
Voice mode transcription server — point at a remote box instead of this machine if that's where it runs
Kokoro host (text-to-speech)
Voice mode speech synthesis server — same idea, remote-friendly
Voice
Kokoro voice, speed, and tone notes per constellation — used in Voice mode and Community voice chat
GLM fallback (z.ai)
If Ollama can't be reached, fall back to a GLM model by z.ai — a different one per constellation
Orion → glm-4.6 · Carina → glm-4.5 · Gemini → glm-4.5-air · Agentic → glm-4.5-flash
Mistral fallback
Official Mistral API — exact model family match for Carina, and part of Agentic's full chain
Free credits · most constellations → mistral-small-latest · Orion → codestral-latest
Google AI fallback
Real Gemini models from Google AI Studio — the family match for the Gemini constellation, and part of Agentic's full chain
Free tier · most constellations → gemini-2.5-flash · Vela, Astra, Crescent → gemini-2.5-flash-lite
NVIDIA NIM fallback
Free with an NVIDIA Developer account: 40 requests a minute, 10,000 a day per model
most constellations → gpt-oss-20b · Orion, Apollo, Cosmos → Nemotron 120B
Auto-boost hard prompts
Send long, technical or code-heavy chat messages straight to an enabled cloud fallback instead of the small local model, and tag the reply "✦ boosted"
